test_title: SSC CHSL Exam 2023 Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 10 Jan, 2024 Shift 1).
subject: general
question:
Select the option that converts the given sentence into the superlative degree.

The river Ganga has some of the purer water on earth.

options.text: The river Ganga has some of the most purest water on earth.
The river Ganga has some of the very purest water on earth.
The river Ganga has some of the more purest water on earth.
The river Ganga has some of the purest water on earth.

solution:
The correct answer is '4' i.e. The river Ganga has some of the purest water on earth.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The original sentence uses the comparative form "**purer**."
 
• In the superlative degree, the comparative adjective "**purer**" changes to "**purest**."
 
• The correct superlative phrase is "some of the **purest **water on earth."

Hence, the correct answer is option 4.
